Package org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.openmetadata.properties.assets.processes

Class RunMetricsProperties

java.lang.Object
org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.openmetadata.properties.ClassificationProperties
org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.openmetadata.properties.ClassificationBeanProperties
org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.openmetadata.properties.assets.processes.RunMetricsProperties
public class RunMetricsProperties extends ClassificationBeanProperties
RunMetricsProperties describes the RunMetrics classification. It is attached to a process and records statistics about the runs of the process: how many times it has run, when, for how long and how much data it handled. These are maintained as the runs are observed, for example from OpenLineage events, and support questions such as how often a process runs and the volume of data it processes.
